FOOTNOTES.text: Walk-up orders: HatchGrab charges 0% on every plan. Use your own card terminal and only your provider's standard fees apply. Card payments through HatchGrab via Stripe are coming soon — Stripe's own charge, currently around 1.4% + 10p on UK and EEA cards, plus 10p per authorisation if you tap on a phone or tablet without a dedicated reader.
Online payments powered by Stripe Connect. Subject to 0.99% HatchGrab platform fee plus Stripe card processing fees (~1.5% + 20p per transaction on standard UK cards).
Device not supplied. There are native kitchen apps for iPhone, iPad and Android, and the kitchen screen also runs on any phone or tablet with a modern browser.

Auto-replies require a Business account on each platform. Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From 1 October 2026 the first 1,000 a month are free. Correct at 16 September 2026; Meta may change its prices, so check with Meta. Replies are AI-generated and can occasionally be wrong.
Kitchen ticket printing requires the HatchGrab kitchen app and a compatible Bluetooth or wired printer (neither supplied). Compatible printers listed in our help centre.

rows.name: Discovery map listing
rows.detail: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.

rows.name: Universal web dashboard
rows.detail: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.

rows.name: QR code
rows.detail: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.

rows.name: Automatic schedule import
rows.detail: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or a photo you already post to Facebook. You just review and confirm.

rows.name: Meal deals & upsells
rows.detail: Bundle items into deals and offer add-ons at checkout to lift the average order.

rows.name: Walk-up order processing
rows.detail: Take and manage orders at the hatch, paid on your own card terminal.

rows.name: Instant sold out toggle
rows.detail: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.

rows.name: Online ordering — Pay at Hatch
rows.detail: Customers order ahead online and pay in person when they collect.

rows.name: iPhone, iPad and Android kitchen app
rows.detail: The fullest way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.

rows.name: Offline Order Protection
rows.detail: If your internet drops mid-service, orders are held safely and sync when you're back — you never lose one.

rows.name: Online payments
rows.detail: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.

rows.name: Advance pre-ordering
rows.detail: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.

rows.name: Pre-order deadline
rows.detail: Set a cut-off time for items that need notice.

rows.name: Customer time slot selection
rows.detail: Customers pick a collection time slot, spreading demand across your service.

rows.name: Kitchen capacity management
rows.detail: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can’t pick it.

rows.name: Automated stock countdown
rows.detail: Set a stock count and it counts down as orders come in, then sells out automatically.

rows.name: Auto-accept online orders
rows.detail: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.

rows.name: Branded QR code
rows.detail: Add your logo to your QR code.

rows.name: Private events
rows.detail: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.

rows.name: Social media posts
rows.detail: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.

rows.name: WhatsApp auto-replies
rows.detail: Auto-reply to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

rows.name: Messenger & Instagram auto-replies
rows.detail: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.

rows.name: Take payment on your phone
rows.detail: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.

rows.name: Advanced reporting
rows.detail: Break sales down by date range, item and event to see what’s really selling.

rows.name: SMS order alerts
rows.detail: Text customers automatically when their order's ready. Will carry an additional charge (price to be confirmed).

rows.name: Multi-device kitchen sync
rows.detail: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.

rows.name: Multi-user access
rows.detail: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.

rows.name: Schedule page on your own website
rows.detail: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight through to its order page.

rows.name: Custom event types & pricing
rows.detail: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.

rows.name: Buzzer tracking
rows.detail: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand one out, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.

rows.name: Kitchen ticket printing
rows.detail: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.

rows.name: Customer-facing display
rows.detail: A screen customers can see showing order numbers and when they’re ready.

rows.name: Digital loyalty stamp cards
rows.detail: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.
